_comment: Razorpay error objects for simulated mode, one per verified error-scenario
test card in the `razorpay-api` skill (doc-verified 2026-09-03). Each key is
the `error.reason` value that card produces, so a simulated batch and a real
test-mode batch normalize through exactly the same mapping table.
Adding a scenario means confirming it against a live test-mode response
first — a fixture built from recollection is a silent-wrong-answer generator.

insufficient_fund.description: Your payment could not be completed due to insufficient account balance. Try another card or payment method.

payment_timed_out.description: Payment was not completed on time. Try again.

gateway_technical_error.description: Payment failed due to a technical error at the bank. Any amount debited will be refunded in 4-5 business days.

payment_cancelled.description: Payment was cancelled by the customer.

card_declined.description: Payment was declined by the bank. Try another card or payment method.

card_disabled_for_online_payments.description: Your card is not enabled for online payments. Contact your bank to enable it, or use another card.

card_number_invalid.description: The card number is invalid. Check the details and try again.

authentication_failed.description: Payment processing failed due to an error at the bank's end. Verification could not be completed.
